image_description: A close-up, low-resolution image of a marine fish, identified as a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow/gold posterior body. A distinct white vertical bar separates the black and yellow regions near the gill cover. The dorsal fin is visible along the top edge, showing a gradient from green/yellow to blue at the very top. The background is dark and indistinct, likely rock or coral.
